metadata.short_desc: Anime images with AnimeAPI at $0.003 per image, no subscription.
metadata.desc: Generate anime images with AnimeAPI: $0.003 per image, prepaid from $5, balance never expires, no subscription, 3 free images for new accounts. Send /anime and a description. Model, orientation and per-user cooldown settings.

api_key.hint: Starts with ank_. Create one at https://animeapi.ai/dashboard/api-keys. New accounts get 3 free images, no card.

model.hint: Price per image: anime $0.003, ultra $0.01, ultra-max $0.02.

allow_model_override.description: Let users pick a model with -m
allow_model_override.hint: Off so users cannot choose a more expensive model.

show_prompt.description: Also send the tags the model received
